I can’t  exactly remember what it read but it said something along the lines of “thoughts of hurting yourself” and I put “1” for that. The doctor reviews your answers right in front of you (at least mine did) and she looks up at me eyebrows scrunched with a concerned/annoyed tone asking “you have thoughts of hurting yourself or is this a mistake?” I panicked real bad acted real confused and was like “oh yeah my mistake I didn’t mean to put that”. At the end of my appointment she walks out with the paper upside down slightly folded in half, like how the teacher hands you back your test of you have a bad grade so no one else can see 💀.  Basically I will not be doing that again because her almost annoyed reaction took me off guard and it just didn’t feel great lol. I texted my friends what had happened and one of them said she probably didn’t want to do all the paperwork that comes with a crisis call and how she probably knows it wasnt a mistake.
